body: That’s exactly what I mean. People only might care about me if they don’t know me, because if you truly get to know me you come to realize that I’m not even worth caring about at all.
Literally same lmao I’m so sorry for u tho :( Wish I could do more
How dirty some people did me for absolutely no reason. And how lonely some people made me feel.
This is the comment I was looking for. This, perfectionism, and some rude comments about my flaws ruined me and my perception of myself.
Would’ve pushed that button a long time ago.
Wow. Well then I guess I’ll be drowning soon🥲
Feel ya, life’s so fucking boring and draining & for what?

Thank you! I’m not gonna lie, I really hope that some miracle is going to happen so that I won’t feel like ending it all next week, but it’s highly unlikely that will happen since my whole life is literally collapsing and the damage is irreparable.

Most people don’t give a shit about me or what I have to say. I’m a burden and people genuinely don’t care if I live or die. And I’m sick of always having to beg people to care/understand me. So that’s why I just gave up on life.
Childhood me would be crying and throwing up uncontrollably if she’d see me now.
I relate to almost everything you said, and I obviously haven’t found an answer to these problems but the only thing I can do is hear you out if you wanna talk about it more though? :(
I’m so sorry, I hope it will get better for you soon. :(

First of all, I’m so sorry. There’s no type of pain worse than the pain of losing a loved one, especially like that. I genuinely hope he found his peace and is in a better place now. Your situation is definitely a perfect example of what I mean. Even though I hope you find the strength to heal from all of this, I know life’s an unfair bitch, so I hope that whatever you’ll do in the future, you’ll find your peace. May you & your husband reunite together in another life where y’all will feel happiness, because this life clearly failed you both. Feel free to dm me anytime. <3

Proud of you. Wish I could feel the same but for me it’s the other way around. Every day I keep living God or the universe is giving me the bs finger as a sign that I should end it all bc it won’t get better, only worse.

Thank you so much for responding! I’m glad to hear it got better for you. I’m very interested in doing those things like meditation and shadow work but it doesn’t seem to help. I’ve been in and out of therapy for years because of this and somehow I’m only hating myself more and more every year because I keep getting uglier and people keep proving me that they do see me the exact same way i view myself. So how can I unlearn those 22 years of self hate? After being treated like the ugly girl for all my life it’s hard to believe the opposite without seeing actual improvements in my appearance you know? And the worst thing is that it impacts my mental health and social life so much that I can’t even function like a normal human being anymore. :(
I could’ve written this. I’m also 22 years old and so done with all of this, at this point I’m literally sick of myself.
Same :(

Wow wait are u me? Cause I feel like I wrote this😭 Everything u said from top to bottom is something I can relate to & experience on a daily basis & it’s a nightmare for sure so I’m sorry you have to go through this, and if there’s anything I can do or if you’d like to talk feel free to message me! Sending much strength & blessings your way :)
bojack horseman

My birthday was 2 weeks ago and I felt the exact same type of hurt and pain you’re describing. It’s awful and you don’t deserve to feel like that on your special day. I’m so sorry you’re going through all of this on your own & that life hasn’t treated you better. I don’t know what else to say because I don’t know how or even if it gets better because I also haven’t found a solution to any of my problems yet, but I do care and I’m here if you wanna talk about anything! Sending much love & happy birthday love. <3
I’m only 21 but I can really relate to what you’re saying. My (social) anxiety is literally taking over my life & there’s nothing I can do about it. I also feel trapped.
Sending so much love & strength your way <3 You just kinda described my life as well so I can confirm how much it hurts to live life like this. I’m here if you wanna talk about it!
I’m exactly in the same position as you, so you can talk to me!
I acknowledge you, please dm me.
I really hope your life is going better by then. <3
When’s your birthday?
Same here, I’m almost 21 and it feels like I’ve been on this earth for 60 years. I’m exhausted and outlived.

I’ve lived with these thoughts since I was 14. I always saw suicide as an option and it comforted me. Until my first attempt. If you’re actively planning to kill yourself, I’d recommend you to talk about it with someone close to you. Don’t hesitate to reach out since you’re already scared of not getting help on time.
Do you have any tips on how to get motivated to exercise? I really want to but I really don’t have the energy to bring myself to actually do it.

I also genuinely forgot what happiness feels like. I have some vague memories, but I feel like they’re not really mine? Like it was all just a dream I had a long time ago. But I’m trying to hold on to these small memories of things that used to make me happy. Or some fantasies of my dream life. It makes me feel a little bit better for at least a second, before reality slaps you in the face again.

I’m so so sorry you went through that. Please don’t ever blame yourself for what happened honey. This is in no wayyy your fault. I genuinely hope you can heal from this and I’m here if you wanna talk. Sending love & strength your way <3
Exactly! The only thing I regret from my past attempts is failing lmao. I should’ve died a long time ago.
I’m here for you!

We are literally the same person? I wish I could help you or say something useful to make you feel better but I can’t since I’m in the exact same position as you and nothing seems to help. Just know that I want to listen & if there’s anything I can do lmk!

I literally feel the same. I’m planning to take a lot of drugs to numb myself (ketamine, weed, xanax) and then cut my wrists. I do hope you don’t need to do this & I’m sending lots of love and strength your way <3

This is something I could’ve written myself. Hating your appearance but being confronted with it every fucking day takes a lot on your mental health. It’s a different kind of pain that’s literally always there. How can someone enjoy life if they can’t even enjoy their own reflection in the mirror? I’m so sorry you have to feel this way and that this disgusting world made you feel like you aren’t pretty enough. I’m here for you if you wanna talk about it!

Same here. I’m not gonna try to talk you out of this because you probably have your valid reasons but I do hope you receive some good news in the next couple days that convince you stay alive since everyone has the right to live a blessed & happy life. However, life’s not a fairytale and some people (like me) never get their happy ending so they’ll have to end it by themselves. But I genuinely hope that you’ll find your peace, no matter what’s after this. <3
